notes.heading: The holder doesn't fit between the Long and the Mount
notes.text: J1's drive hangs from the End Cap: motor, Attach, flexspline, then the circular spline {spline_face_z} up, with the Base Stator Holder seated on it. That puts the holder's 4 mm flange across the joint where 004 seats the Long on the Mount: {holder_into_long} mm up into the Long and {holder_into_mount} mm into the Mount. A different motor length moves the holder (007.1 C-101), but only up or down: with the Long seated on the Mount there is no gap for it at any length.

notes.heading: How J1's stack closes
notes.text: Each part is placed on the one above it, from the End Cap, which sits flush with the Long's top face in the upper 6810. Motor length is C-101's {motor_len} mm.

rows.text: Attach's land beyond the lower 6810, below

notes.heading: The J1 joint
notes.text: The disc lies on the Long's top face, on the Long's strakes standing {strake_proud} mm proud, with its notches over the all-threads. The Pivot Skirt hangs from the Main Pivot (turned 180° from its own frame) on three M3 screws in its lower side holes, z {skirt_span}, its round part reaching {skirt_above_long} mm above the Long's top face; the disc's edge is {disc_skirt_radial} mm inside it.
